The '''MC95C Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] that was active during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Many MC95C [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]s were present on [[Exegol]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]] between the Resistance and the [[Sith Eternal]].

==Description==
[[File:MC95C_Star_Cruiser_angle_2.png|thumb|left|220px|An MC95C Star Cruiser]]
The MC95C [[Star Cruiser]] was class of [[Star]] [[Cruiser]]<ref name="Ship ST" /> of [[Mon Calamari]] design.<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> The MC95C Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> characteristically had a round shell that covered the [[hull]] on the rear half of the vessel, and the front elongated into a narrow bow structure that contained a large dorsal and a large ventral thin fin. It was equipped with at least two [[hangar]] bays towards the front of the vessel.<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> It was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], which gave it the capability of entering [[hyperspace]] at [[lightspeed]], and was equipped with [[engine]]s.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Similar to other Mon Calamari ship designs,<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> the MC95C Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> had a bulbous [[hull]] with differing surface modules, and had several [[antenna]] on a dorsal module towards the rear as well as forward-facing antenna at the bow of the ship near an ordnance pod. The ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the forward command section near the bow of the vessel, and also contained a command tower towards the rear of the vessel. It was armed with several [[laser cannon]]s.<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> The MC95C Star Cruiser<ref name="Ship ST" /> could be disabled when struck by powerful [[Force lightning]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Role==
As a [[capital ship]], the MC95C Star Cruiser had the ability to participate in [[Space warfare|naval warfare]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
[[File:MC95C_Star_Cruiser_Exegol.png|thumb|right|150px|One of many MC95C Star Cruisers at Exegol]]
MC95C Star Cruisers were in service by the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> the [[First Order]], a military junta that succeeded the fallen Old [[Galactic Empire]], and the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary force with roots to the dissolved [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and the defunct [[New Republic]].<ref name="BFA">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Alliance and Republic heroes [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] were sent on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to rally the citizens of [[the galaxy]] in order to reinforce the Resistance, which had traveled to the ancient [[Sith]] redoubt [[Planet|world]] of [[Exegol]] in an attempt to defeat the resurgent [[Sith Eternal]], which allied itself with the First Order, and save the [[galaxy]] from their rule.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:GalaxyFleet.png|thumb|left|250px|The 14,000 strong citizens' fleet contained many MC95C Star Cruisers, among others.]]
As the Resistance came close to defeat and suffered heavy losses, an enormous [[Citizens' Fleet]] of 14,000 vessels from across the galaxy arrived at Exegol and participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]], including numerous MC95C Star Cruisers. Reinforced, the combined galactic force and the Resistance attacked the [[Final Order]], a massive fleet of planet-[[Death|killing]] [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that numbered above 1,000 ships. As the two [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and [[Ben Solo]] fought the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] on the surface at the [[Sith Citadel]], [[Darth]] Sidious gained [[The Force|Force power]] from the [[Force dyad]] between Rey and Solo, and afterwards unleashed a torrent of powerful Force lightning at the galactic fleet, disabling the vessels.<ref name="Episode IX" />

After Rey regained her strength and confronted Sidious once again, the lightning dissipated and the fleet regained its foothold. Darth Sidious was then eventually disintegrated by his own power after Rey deflected his lightning, finally killing him. The remaining [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the Sith Eternal on Exegol were annihilated, and an [[uprising against the First Order]] took place throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==

Over the span of a day or so, I kitbashed the Home One ship to fill out our fleet. When ya gotta do what ya gotta do.|Lucasfilm Art designer James Clyne|<ref name="James Clyne">{{Instagram|username=clyne_design|url=p/CHyXEEsjrDu|name=[[James Clyne]]|quote=Mon Calamari variant for the battle of Exegol. At a time in the production when we desperately needed more ships. Over the span of a day or so, I kitbashed the Home One ship to fill out our fleet. When ya gotta do what ya gotta do.|archivedate=20201119235706}}</ref>}}
[[File:TROS_unidentified_Mon_Cala_cruiser.png|thumb|right|180px|Concept art of an MC95C Star Cruiser at Exegol.]]
The MC95C Star Cruiser first appeared in the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] and the [[sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> It was first identified in an installment of ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' on [[StarWarsKids.com]] in [[2020]].<ref name="Ship ST" /> The MC95C Star Cruiser was created when post-production needed more ships for the citizens' fleet, and over a day or so, [[Lucasfilm]] art designer [[James Clyne]] kitbashed the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]] ''[[Home One]]'' to create the design.<ref name="James Clyne" />
